visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and glasses is sitting on a wooden kitchen floor, grimacing and clutching his leg while wearing a grey t-shirt and black shorts. The room is a modern, white-themed kitchen with sleek cabinets and natural lighting. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) A young girl in a pink shirt sits at a dining table, meticulously placing plastic organs into a small model skeleton. The man watches her from the side, providing guidance. The setting remains the well-lit home interior with wooden floors. (3) The man prepares a meal in the kitchen, cutting a whole fish on a wooden board. He then adds sliced onions, salt, pepper, and garlic powder to a metal tray. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the fresh ingredients. (4) The scene shifts to the man eating the cooked fish with chopsticks directly from the tray. He shows the food close to the lens. A glass of iced tea sits next to the meal. White subtitles describe his reaction to the flavor. (5) The man is now in a brightly lit supermarket aisle wearing a tan shirt. He browses shelves filled with condiments and then looks at packaged seafood in a green shopping basket. Yellow labels on the fish are clearly visible. (6) Back in the kitchen, the man prepares 'Bak Kut Teh'. He displays a bowl of raw meat and bones before adding them to a white ceramic pot of boiling water. The background features a modern oven and clean countertops. (7) The man sits at the table, eating the meat soup with rice. Steam rises from the bowl, and he uses a spoon to show the broth. He gestures with his hands while talking to the camera. (8) A fast-paced montage shows the man exercising in the living area. He performs kettlebell swings, weighted squats, jumping jacks, lunges, and mountain climbers. He looks fatigued, sweating, and breathing heavily. (9) He concludes the video sitting back on the floor, looking exhausted. The screen fades to a simple yellow animation of a boy and girl before ending.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a male voice emitting a high-pitched pained grunt, immediately followed by upbeat, high-tempo acoustic background music with bright synthesizer textures. The speaker's tone shifts to a friendly, animated delivery as he interacts with a child. (2) A sharp percussive thud marks the start of the next phase as the man begins cooking. The sounds of rhythmic chopping on a board and the rustling of plastic bags are clearly audible over the persistent major-key BGM. (3) A distinct liquid splash sound occurs as ingredients are added to a tray. The man's narration is energetic and clear, with frequent pitch modulations to maintain viewer interest. A 'ding' sound effect emphasizes the completion of a task. (4) Mechanical clicks and the sliding of a tray trigger a new phase. During the eating segment, crisp crunching and smacking sounds (mouth SFX) are layered with enthusiastic vocal commentary. The BGM remains a consistent, lighthearted bed. (5) Ambient supermarket hum and distant muffled chatter introduce the grocery segment. The man's voice remains dominant and upbeat. A metallic thud of a pot lid signifies the return to the kitchen for the second meal preparation. (6) The final phase features heavy breathing, strained grunts, and the rhythmic thudding of feet against the floor during a workout. The metallic clank of a kettlebell is prominent. The video concludes with a whimsical synth jingle and a final soft vocal farewell.
